name: Meeting subtitle
text: Microscaling VQ, activation refinement & relational KL
本次汇报顺序：已实现方法 → 所有有代表性的本地 LIBERO+ 闭环结果 → future intervention → 旧 loss 与闭环的差距 → Soft-bin + relational KL → potential contributions 与下一步。所有闭环数据来自已完成本地报告，截止 20 October 2026。

name: 614 target Linears; update codebooks + row gains. Laten
text: 614 target Linears; update codebooks + row gains. Latents exclude frame 0; motor loss excludes gripper.

已实现的 Fast-WAM weight quantization 框架。Teacher 和 student 共享 observations、language、proprioception、sampler seeds。Student 通过自身生成的 future 构建 video K/V；不注入 teacher future 训练。所有 614 target Linear 覆盖 video/action/proprio 等目标模块。Weight calibration 更新 codebooks 和 row gains；indices、B32 exponents 和 transforms 固定。图为结构示意，tokens 数量不代表真实 tensor 大小。

text: 4 core bpw  +  0.25 B32 bpw  +  codebooks / gains / transforms  ≈  4.27 bpw

name: Fixed indices + exponents; calibrate codebooks + row ga
text: Fixed indices + exponents; calibrate codebooks + row gains. VQ codewords remain BF16 values.

每一 target Linear 共享两个 K=256,d=4 BF16 codebooks。每四个 scalar weight 使用两条 uint8 indices，core cost 为 16/4=4 bpw。每 output row 保留 BF16 RMS row gain r；沿 input dimension 每 32 个 weights 用一个 uint8 exponent，贡献 8/32=0.25 bpw。e_g=round(log2(block_RMS/r_row))，拟合中固定。有效预算含 codebooks、gains、tails 和 transforms，Fast-WAM row-scale≈4.020873，microscaling≈4.270878。Weight calibration 用 FP32 masters/STE 调整 BF16-stored books 与 row gains。

name: Learn D per channel + r_l per Linear on C80; keep VQ we
text: Learn D per channel + r_l per Linear on C80; keep VQ weights fixed. BF16 KV; native VQ kernel pending.

这是 per-input-channel scaling + per-Linear activation clipping，不是每 channel 一个 clipping threshold。D=2^log2_D 为每个 physical input channel 一个正的 continuous scale；r_l 为每 Linear 一个 ratio，跨 token/denoising steps 共享。先对 input 施加已冻结 Smooth0.5/H128，然后 v=z/D；每 token s=r_l max|v|/7，signed A4 q=clamp(round(v/s),-7,7)。decoded BF16 Wq 乘相同 D 后以 BF16 缓存。忽略 rounding 时 compensating Linear 恒等；已 quantized 情况下改变 error。C80 refinement 从 C8 rho1.5 开始，80 updates，只训 D/r_l，VQ 参数冻结。使用 coupled dynamic-absmax surrogate 和 STE。
